policy_name: Vendor Due Diligence and Screening Policy
description: New vendors, high-risk vendors, and spend at or above the screening threshold require completed due-diligence screening, including a sanctions/watchlist check, before spend is incurred.

policy_references.citation: Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Prevention and Control) Act, 2011-23 (as amended by the 2019-22 Amendment Act)
policy_references.authority: Anti-Money Laundering Authority (AMLA) / Financial Intelligence Unit, Barbados
policy_references.notes: Establishes AML/CFT due-diligence duties, including ongoing customer due diligence. Does not specify a numeric dollar threshold for when screening is required, so screening_required_above_amount remains an internal-policy value.

policy_references.citation: CFATF (Caribbean Financial Action Task Force) member compliance with the FATF Recommendations
policy_references.notes: Barbados is a CFATF member jurisdiction; CFATF monitors implementation of the FATF Recommendations, which is the basis for sanctions/watchlist screening as a compliance expectation.
Sets screening_required_above_amount and the new/high-risk vendor screening triggers. No numeric regulatory floor was found for these values.
